label: Statutory divisions
description: Number of divisions into which the district is divided by statute (28 U.S.C. §§ 81-131; 48 U.S.C. § 1615 for the Virgin Islands). 0 = the statute names no divisions (many such courts create divisions by local rule, which this does not count).
caveats: Statute current through Pub. L. 119-142 (Nov. 10, 2026); period = 2026. E.D. Tex.: § 124(c) says 'seven divisions' but lists six; the six listed are counted.

label: Statutory places of holding court
description: Number of distinct places where the statute says court shall (or, for Odessa, may) be held. 'Champaign/Urbana' and 'Eugene or Springfield' count as two places each; a described site (D. Md. Southern Division; the Middletown-Wallkill area) counts as one.
caveats: Statutory places are not the same as the courthouses a court actually uses. Title 48 names no place for D. Guam or D.V.I.; those two districts have no value (see data gaps).

label: County-equivalents in the district
description: Number of Census 2025 county-equivalents (counties, parishes, boroughs, census areas, independent cities, planning regions, municipios, islands) assigned to the district in county_district.csv.
caveats: Counties divided by a statutory carve-out (Yellowstone NP; Fort Bragg/Camp MacKall; FCI Butner) are counted once, in the district that holds the rest of the county.
